title: EU financial regulators warn consumers on the risks of crypto-assets
notes: Joint warning by the EBA, ESMA and EIOPA to EU consumers in March 2022. It predates the later MiCA regime and does not state the current rights of an individual investor.

title: EU Supervisory Authorities warn consumers of risks and limited protection for certain crypto-assets and providers
notes: Joint EU consumer warning by the EBA, EIOPA and ESMA. Describes categories and checks under MiCA as of October 2025; it cannot establish a provider's current authorisation or guarantee recovery for an individual case.

title: The EBA and ESMA analyse recent developments in crypto-assets
notes: EBA and ESMA summary of a joint report on DeFi and crypto lending, borrowing and staking. Market estimates and risk observations are dated 2025 analysis, not current measures or findings about a named protocol.

title: ESAs publish key tips to help consumers detect, prevent, and act on online frauds and scams
notes: Joint EU authorities' consumer announcement introducing fraud factsheets. Examples and preventive tips are educational; they cannot identify whether a particular message or person is genuine.

title: Investor Alert: Social Media ‘Investment Group’ Imposter Scams Continue to Rise
notes: FINRA US investor alert about reported social-media investment-group scams, including crypto pitches. Reported patterns are historical warnings, not a finding that any specific group or individual is fraudulent.

title: 5 Ways Fraudsters May Lure Victims Into Scams Involving Crypto Asset Securities
notes: SEC Office of Investor Education and Advocacy staff alert. Describes hypothetical and reported fraud tactics, not findings about a named opportunity or a Commission rule.

title: Investor Bulletin: Crypto Asset Interest-bearing Accounts
notes: SEC investor education bulletin about crypto interest-bearing accounts at publication. Insurance descriptions and the BlockFi order are historical and do not determine current account coverage or a company's current legal status.

title: Relationship Investment Scams – Investor Alert
notes: Joint SEC, CFTC, FINRA and NASAA investor alert on relationship investment scams. Illustrative warning signs do not establish that an individual correspondent is a fraudster.

title: Group Chats as a Gateway to Investment Scams – Investor Alert
notes: SEC Office of Investor Education and Assistance staff alert. Morocoin allegations are SEC charges, not a final adjudication; general examples are not findings about a named chat.

title: Relationship Investment Scams: What They Are and Tips to Avoid Them
notes: FINRA investor education article on historical relationship investment scam patterns and diligence. Cannot validate a live platform, account or person.

title: What did EU supervisors warn about losing an entire crypto investment in 2022?
summary: This is the 2022 consumer warning, not a prediction for a particular asset or today's portfolio.
